scope_note: Admin SPA foundation — React + MUI v6 Material Design 3, routing, global state, Login / Forgot Password / Reset Password screens
acceptance_criteria: apps/web bootstrapped with Vite + React + TypeScript strict
MUI v6 theme follows docs/03-DESIGN.md spec
React Router configured with protected routes (redirect to /login if no token)
Login screen: email + password, JWT stored in memory, refresh cookie handled automatically
Forgot Password screen: email input, calls POST /api/admin/auth/password/forgot
Reset Password screen: reads token from URL, calls POST /api/admin/auth/password/reset
